parole.testo: Back-formation from taxonomic name Hadrosauridae, from Ancient Greek ἁδρός (hadrós, “strong”) + σαύρᾱ (saúrā, “lizard”).

parole.significato: Clitopilus (genus of fungi in the family Entolomataceae)
parole.testo: From mech + -ovka. * (Clitopilus): First used by Czech botanist Jan Bezděk in 1901. The name probably refers to the fact that the fungus often grows in moss (Czech mech). * (moss animal): Calque of taxonomic name Bryozoa, from Ancient Greek βρύον (brúon, “moss”) + ζῷα (zōîa), which is a plural of ζῷ

From pták (“bird”) + -o- + pysk (“lip”). Calque of taxonomic name Ornithorhynchus, from Ancient Greek ὄρνιθ- (órnith-) (the stem of ὄρνις (órnis, “bird”)) + ῥύγχος (rhúnkhos, “snout”); Coined by Jan Svatopluk Presl (1791–1849).
